mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER) AS MEMBER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT) AS CONTENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE STATUS != 'DELETED') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW) AS REVIEW_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_REPORT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS REPORT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS BUSINESS_REQUEST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS PRODUCT_REQUEST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS EVENT_REQUEST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS SETTLEMENT_WAITING_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER_NO) FROM ACCESS_LOG WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS VISITOR_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, EMAIL AS EMAIL, PHONE AS PHONE, STATUS AS STATUS, CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM MEMBER WHERE ROLE = 'USER'
AND ( MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY MEMBER_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )
DELETE FROM DELIVERY WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, R.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, R.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, R.RATING AS RATING, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS CONTENT, R.STATUS AS STATUS, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT, 0 AS COMMENT_COUNT, R.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO WHERE R.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, R.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, R.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, R.RATING AS RATING, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS CONTENT, R.STATUS AS STATUS, COUNT(RR.REPORT_NO) AS REPORT_COUNT, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT, 0 AS COMMENT_COUNT, R.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO JOIN REVIEW_REPORT RR ON RR.CONTENT_REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO AND RR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'CONTENT' WHERE R.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
GROUP BY R.REVIEW_NO, R.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, R.CONTENT_NO, R.RATING, R.REVIEW_TEXT, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING AS RATING, PR.CONTENT AS CONTENT, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT, 0 AS COMMENT_COUNT, PR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = PR.MEMBER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING AS RATING, PR.CONTENT AS CONTENT, COUNT(RR.REPORT_NO) AS REPORT_COUNT, 0 AS LIKE_COUNT, 0 AS COMMENT_COUNT, PR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = PR.MEMBER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO JOIN REVIEW_REPORT RR ON RR.PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO = PR.REVIEW_NO AND RR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
GROUP BY PR.REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING, PR.CONTENT, PR.CREATED_AT ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_NO AS REQUEST_NO, NULL AS BUSINESS_NAME, TITLE AS EVENT_TITLE, START_DATE AS START_DATE, END_DATE AS END_DATE, CREATED_AT AS REQUESTED_AT, STATUS AS STATUS, NULL AS DESCRIPTION FROM EVENT WHERE 1 = 1
AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY EVENT_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, P.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE AS PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE AS PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE AS DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS AS STATUS, PI.IMAGE_PATH AS MAIN_IMAGE, P.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT P JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, NVL(D.STATUS, 'PREPARING') AS STATUS, OI.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, O.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE OI.STATUS != 'CANCELED'
AND P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY O.ORDER_NO DESC

SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO AS CANCEL_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, CR.REASON AS REASON, CR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CR.MEMBER_NO WHERE CR.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT B.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, M.EMAIL AS EMAIL, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS BUSINESS_NUMBER, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, B.GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, B.CUSTOM_RATE AS CUSTOM_RATE, B.STATUS AS STATUS, B.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY B.BUSINESS_NO DESC

SELECT B.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, M.EMAIL AS EMAIL, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS BUSINESS_NUMBER, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, B.GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, B.CUSTOM_RATE AS CUSTOM_RATE, B.STATUS AS STATUS, B.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT S.SETTLEMENT_NO AS SETTLEMENT_NO, S.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, S.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, S.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, S.APPLIED_GRADE AS APPLIED_GRADE, S.APPLIED_RATE AS APPLIED_RATE, S.FEE_AMOUNT AS FEE_AMOUNT, S.SETTLED_AMOUNT AS SETTLED_AMOUNT, S.STATUS AS STATUS, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, S.SETTLED_AT AS SETTLED_AT, S.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM SETTLEMENT S JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = S.BUSINESS_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY S.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SETTLEMENT SET STATUS = #{status}, SETTLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN SYSDATE ELSE SETTLED_AT END WHERE SETTLEMENT_NO = #{settlementNo}
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, LOG.LAST_ACCESS_AT AS LAST_ACCESS_AT, LOG.ACCESS_IP AS ACCESS_IP, NVL(CLICK.CONTENT_USE_COUNT, 0) AS CONTENT_USE_COUNT, NVL(CLICK.PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT, 0) AS PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT CONTENT_NO) AS CONTENT_USE_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_CLICK_LOG WHERE MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MEMBER_NO ) CLICK ON CLICK.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO, MAX(CREATED_AT) AS LAST_ACCESS_AT, MAX(ACCESS_IP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS ACCESS_IP FROM ACCESS_LOG WHERE MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MEMBER_NO ) LOG ON LOG.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE M.ROLE = 'USER' ORDER BY LOG.LAST_ACCESS_AT DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TMDB_ID AS TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE AS TITLE, C.ORIGINAL_TITLE AS ORIGINAL_TITLE, C.OVERVIEW AS OVERVIEW, C.POSTER_PATH AS POSTER_PATH, C.BACKDROP_PATH AS BACKDROP_PATH, C.RELEASE_DATE AS RELEASE_DATE, C.GENRE_TEXT AS GENRE_TEXT, C.RUNTIME AS RUNTIME, C.EPISODE_COUNT AS EPISODE_COUNT, C.DIRECTOR AS DIRECTOR, C.CAST_NAMES AS CAST_NAMES, C.AGE_RATING AS AGE_RATING, C.TMDB_SCORE AS TMDB_SCORE, C.VIEW_COUNT AS VIEW_COUNT, ( SELECT LISTAGG(OP.PLATFORM_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OP.PLATFORM_NAME) FROM CONTENT_PLATFORM CP JOIN OTT_PLATFORM OP ON OP.PLATFORM_NO = CP.PLATFORM_NO WHERE CP.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO ) AS PLATFORM_NAMES, C.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT FROM CONTENT C WHERE 1 = 1
AND C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY C.CONTENT_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}, GENRE_TEXT = #{genreText}, CAST_NAMES = #{castNames}, OVERVIEW = #{overview}, RUNTIME = #{runtime}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT PLATFORM_NO AS PLATFORM_NO, PLATFORM_NAME AS PLATFORM_NAME, LOGO_IMAGE AS LOGO_IMAGE, SITE_URL AS SITE_URL, IS_ACTIVE AS IS_ACTIVE FROM OTT_PLATFORM ORDER BY PLATFORM_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE OTT_PLATFORM SET SITE_URL = #{siteUrl}, IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PLATFORM_NO = #{platformNo}
